highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.5 delivers targeted bug fixes and Apple TFM improvements backported from the v4 line.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found fixed for .NET 9
bullets.detail: Resolves a `DllNotFoundException` for the WinUI projection DLL when consuming SkiaSharp from .NET 9 WinUI applications.
Library TFMs now use the versioned `26.0` moniker; app TFMs use the unversioned form, backporting the fix from the v4 line.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backport of the Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFM corrections
